description.narrative:
Integrated Aids Programme of the Catholic Diocese of Ndola has been in existence since 1993 in response to an increase in the number of HIV/AIDS patients and Orphaned & Vulnerable Children on the Copperbelt. The Programme operates in 7 Districts of the Copperbelt Province of Zambia namely Ndola, Kitwe, Luanshya, Chingola, Mufulira, Mpongwe and Chililabombwe, covering 73 Shanty compounds and operates through 13 community Home based care programmes. Integrated Aids Program is very much involved in the Health, Education and development Projects through different interventions related to care and support for people living with HIV-AIDS, OVC Care and Support, livelihood support and support for community caregivers. The overall objective is to empower the communities with improved health, knowledge and skills in order for them to be self-supporting.
This project is bridge fund for the period between 1st September, 2017 and 31st August, 2018 and will have the following objectives: • To continue providing care and support to PLWHA with emphasis on developing their resilience • To continue promoting, facilitating and strengthening socio-economic empowerment for PLWHA, and the community volunteers • To continue support the welfare of community caregivers
